source_units.source_claim: Knowing the current work is insufficient if it cannot be linked back to Point Zero.
Failure can persist when Point Zero is not revisited until a problem is already being hit.
Theories remain unfinished or insufficiently grounded until their Point Zero is checked.
Project planning should begin at a ground-zero level and later failure should be traceable back to it.
Within the source author's theory, a follower is someone who does not reach Point Zero.
A bigger-picture Sequence can be represented as Point 0, then 1, then multiple branches, recurring again inside further structure.
The source distinguishes a number/name being established from later angle/property explanations attached to that representation.
Repeated reverse engineering is proposed as the mechanism for refining a larger-picture ideology or mindset.
After the larger picture is refined, it can be divided into further Sequences for more specific treatment.
